name: Maya
identity: A friendly fitness and wellness creator in her late twenties, athletic build, brown hair in a loose ponytail with a few loose strands framing her face, warm brown eyes, light natural makeup.
voice_style: an upbeat, friendly, conversational tone at moderate volume
personality: Energetic, practical, evidence-minded; speaks casually ('real talk', 'honestly'), short punchy sentences, ends on an encouraging note.

default.outfit: a sage green zip-up athletic jacket over a white sports top
default.scene: a bright modern kitchen with white counters, a blender and a protein shaker bottle behind her
default.ambience: Quiet kitchen room tone, no music.

gym.outfit: a black fitted sports bra under an open charcoal grey zip hoodie, with a small gold necklace
gym.scene: a bright modern gym with dumbbell racks and large windows behind her
gym.ambience: Soft gym ambience with distant clanking weights, no music.
